1.e4 Nf6 2.e5 Nd5 3.d4 d6 4.c4 Nb6 5.f4.strategy: The natural recapture: it keeps three pawns in the centre and half-opens the f-file for White's pieces. But the f-pawn no longer stands behind e5, and Black can attack the pawns on e5 and d4 with pieces.

Attacks d4, the base of White's pawn chain, at once. The whole defence aims at knocking out the support of the centre, and the knight adds a second attacker to the pawn while White is still developing.
Develops the bishop outside the pawn chain before ...e6 closes it in. It adds nothing against d4, so White gets a moment to consolidate the big centre with natural development.
